about: Hello! My name is José Henrique, and I’m an independent game designer based in São Paulo, Brazil. I’m also Amanda Sparks, a drag queen and cosplayer who creates games inspired by my drag persona!

I have a degree in Industrial Design and Game Production from Senac. I’ve released several games under the Amand.APPs label, including Shade Forest, a platformer where you control a drag queen navigating the Shade Forest, and Spikes on High Heels, a volleyball game that competed in the Diversity category at BIG Festival 2019.
I started doing drag in 2011, and I can say I was part of the first wave of Brazil’s new generation of drag queens — those who emerged after RuPaul’s Drag Race became popular.

I performed at numerous clubs in São Paulo, doing shows and DJ sets, but I never fully immersed myself in the drag world because I was always torn between that side of my life and my work as a game designer. I used to think that the time spent rehearsing performances, practicing makeup, and so on could be spent developing a game instead — and vice versa.
So, in 2014, I decided to bring these two sides of myself together: Henrique, the game designer, and Amanda, the drag queen. I started creating games based on my character.

That’s how Shade Forest came to life — a game entirely created, programmed, designed, animated, and published by me (play Shade Forest). So far, Shade Forest has only been available on mobile platforms, but a PC version is also in development.
The game also gave birth to Amand.APPs, the brand I use to release my games, which go beyond the Shade Forest series. (www.amandapps.com)

But I don’t just make games — I play them a lot, too. I’ve been gaming my entire life, from childhood through my teenage years and into adulthood. I’ve always felt the need to share my thoughts about games with someone, and that’s how Drageek came about: a channel where I talk about video games and all sorts of geek culture (YouTube channel).
It’s still a baby channel, and, just like my games, everything is recorded, edited, and animated by me.
One of the main reasons I started the channel was to show that the gaymer world isn’t entirely dominated by straight guys, haha!

And since I have a background in design and postgraduate studies in games from Senac, I bring a very critical eye to every game I play. Art, level design, game feel, story, performance — nothing escapes my thorough evaluation!
